description: This file defines the ConfigurationResolver class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for resolving configuration values from environment variables and ini files, with support for profiles and custom config locations.

classes.name: ConfigurationResolver
classes.description: Class providing static methods to resolve AWS SDK configuration values from environment variables and ini files.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves configuration value by checking environment variables, then shared config files, then default.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value from environment variables, converting type if necessary.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value from ini file, supporting profiles and subsections.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Gets the user's home directory from environment variables.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigFilename
methods.description: Determines default config file location based on environment or default path.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts string values to specified types (bool, int).

methods.name: retrieveValueFromIniSubsection
methods.description: Retrieves nested ini subsection values based on options.
